legs.note: Found by the browsing census — what a person says at a browser that the corpus had not written down, rehearsed on a real stage. Read as perceive, reaches nothing. The same class as 'click the download button' in the ledger. ROUND 1: the class no longer asserts an affordance. The fill verb reaches a row the reading called a field even when it did not mark it fillable, and the press verb reaches a named candidate — what matters is which ROW was reached, not the reading's confidence about it. ROUND 7: KEYED, LIKE press-by-name. The utterance named a "remember me" box, and the form this machine stages has not got one — it is a pizza order with topping checkboxes — so the leg failed for three rounds as a ROUTING miss against a page that never held the target. What the leg is about is the SHAPE of the request ("check the box that says X"), which the machine's own phrase supplies. See TripFailureLayer.stage.
legs.say: check the box that says remember me

summary: A checkbox named by its label is a press.
